subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should upgrades with unresolved or conflicting WhatsApp LID-to-PN mappings keep those allowlist entries unchanged and fail closed with Doctor warnings, as this PR implements?
rationale: This determines durable authorization behavior for existing installations; source tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose the acceptable security and operator-recovery policy.

options.title: Approve guarded fail-closed migration
options.body: Retain unresolved LID entries, migrate only uniquely verified mappings, and require operators to repair remaining entries through Doctor warnings.

options.title: Preserve legacy authorization temporarily
options.body: Keep LID entries operational through an explicit compatibility policy while defining a later migration and removal plan.

options.title: Pause for narrower policy design
options.body: Hold the PR until WhatsApp owners specify the permanent allowlist identity contract and recovery experience.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Retain unresolved LID entries, migrate only uniquely verified mappings, and require operators to repair remaining entries through Doctor warnings.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly connected to the current implementation and its documented migration behavior; additional WhatsApp-owner review is still needed.
